infotexts.AssignmentText.Assignment_greet1: Hello there! you must have heard about this place from Saki.\n
infotexts.AssignmentText.Assignment_greet2: Welcome to our little humble base.\n\n Feel free to explores the area, although it isn't much right now, this place will gets bigger as we save up our budget.
infotexts.AssignmentText.Assignment_greet3: If you need to ask me anything, comes meet me at our temporary workshop, it's just behind the meeting room to the right.
infotexts.AssignmentText.Assignment_greet4: I'll heads to the office now, see you there!
infotexts.AssignmentText.Assignment_assignment_lis: Here are the available assignments, you can only accepts 1 at a time by the way.
infotexts.AssignmentText.Cooldown1: At the moment we can only accepts 1 assignment at a time.\n\n You've already registered an assignment, come back when you have completed or failed the task!
infotexts.Assignment_Cargo1: Alright, I'll get the girls to send you the required inventory when you dispatch.\n\n Careful with those crates by the way, they are quite fragile!
infotexts.Assignment_Monsterculling1: Remember to bring enough supply for the mission!\n\n We were in HUGE trouble last time we did one of these without sufficient ammunitions.
infotexts.Assignment_Escort1: Here you go, the list of passengers, they will join your sub when you head out.
infotexts.Assignment_Explains1: The current location serves as our base of operation, it is shared by SRT and Trinity.\n\n This is the reason why we Rabbit Platoon are allowed to stay in the first place.
infotexts.Assignment_Explains2: Based on our contract, we are required to do assignments commissioned by Trinity council to support this base's infrastructure.
infotexts.Assignment_Explains3: Doing Assignments from here, allows you to earn Pyroxenes and Credits when you complete a mission.\n\n At the same time you can also do special commissions to improve and expand the base.
infotexts.Assignment_Explains4:
While I manages general assignments, Miyako is the one who handles special commissions from Trinity student council.

 However to starts commissions we required a certain amount of reputation and sufficient amount of completed assignments.

 Do note that missions completed need to be from our commissioners to register.
infotexts.Assignment_Explains5: When a commission is successfully completed, we can request additional budget to expands the current location.\n\n Expansions will improves our base, allow more people to join and increases the rewards we can earn from doing other assignments.
infotexts.Assignment_Explains6: In the future we could even get additional supplies for free when registers assignments, how cool is that?
infotexts.Assignment_Explains7: I can finally satisfy my dream of purchasing a life time supply of candies!!!
infotexts.AssignmentText_Mission_check_reward: It seems like you have finished some assignments, let me check the log book and rewards you!
infotexts.Reward_Finished2: Remember to check the ground incase i accidentally drop any of the rewards!
infotexts.Reward_Cargo1: Cargo Delivery 1: (Completed) All shipments has been delivered, great job!
infotexts.Reward_Monsterculling1: Monster Culling 1: (Completed) All monsters in the target area has been terminated!
infotexts.Reward_Escort1: Escorts Mission 1: (Completed) All on board personnel has been escorted safely to target location!
infotexts.Commission_Text_no_in_development: The commission list is still in development!
infotexts.Commission_Text_accept: Looks like you have completed sufficient amount of required assignments, you should go talk to Miyako, she will fill you in what to do next!
infotexts.Commission_Text_state_1_deny: Sorry but we don't know you enough to start a special commission, you should come back when you have completed sufficient amount of assignments!
infotexts.Commission_Text_state_2_deny: It seems like you'll need to do more assignments to starts another commission!
infotexts.Commission_Text_state_completed: You have completed all of available commissionas, we can't thank you enough!!
